mapper.sql: id, service_account_id, token_prefix, token_hash, permissions, expires_at, last_used_at, revoked_at, revoked_by, created_by, created_at, is_deleted, deleted_at, deleted_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_mcp_token (service_account_id, token_prefix, token_hash, permissions, expires_at, created_by) VALUES (#{serviceAccountId}, #{tokenPrefix}, #{tokenHash}, #{permissions}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_mcp_token WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM ai_mcp_token WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM ai_mcp_token WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC
